title: Weibo Lifestyle UGC Dataset Schema
description: Defines the structure of Weibo posts scraped from lifestyle-related keywords (护肤, 健身, 旅行, 穿搭, 美食).

post_id.title: Post ID
post_id.description: Unique identifier of the Weibo post.

text_raw.title: Post Text
text_raw.description: Cleaned textual content of the Weibo post.

created_at.title: Created Time
created_at.description: Timestamp when the post was published (ISO or Weibo time format).

likes.title: Likes
likes.description: Number of likes the post received.

reposts.title: Reposts
reposts.description: Number of times the post was reposted.

comments.title: Comments
comments.description: Number of comments on the post.

pics.title: Images
pics.description: Comma-separated list of image URLs attached to the post.

author_id.title: Author ID
author_id.description: Unique identifier of the post’s author.

author_name.title: Author Name
author_name.description: Display name of the post’s author.

verified.title: Verified User
verified.description: Whether the author is a verified Weibo user.

followers.title: Followers
followers.description: Number of followers the author has.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Comma-separated list of hashtags mentioned in the post.
